race.comment: THAT IS JUSTICE (12) makes most appeal among the newcomers after winning a trial at this venue and she lands in a winnable maiden. May need a touch of luck from the barrier, but she's showing promising signs at the trials and can make a winning start to her career. KEPPEL GATE (10) brings the strongest exposed sprint form, having charged home for third at Northam last week, beaten a length and a half. Likely to get back from the draw again, but drops in weight and looks primed for a strong showing. INCREDIBLE MR FOX (6) was behind her in that same Northam race and has been honest enough through a third and fourth this campaign, with barrier one a useful offset to the quick back-up. RATTLE THE CAGE (2) resumes after five months, but his Kalgoorlie debut third on soft ground was sound and a close second in his latest trial keeps him in the mix fresh. MASTER HUDSON (9) is another debutant who has shown some ability at the trials and won't be far away.
